subject: Infinite Nature status: pipeline reproduced, long-horizon drift is the demo risk
body:
Lucia, Deshawn,

Status. The released pipeline reproduces end-to-end in our environment - renderer container included, thanks Oyin - and the interactive frontend runs the pretrained model at demo-acceptable frame rates.

The demo risk is long-horizon drift. Perpetual generation means errors compound: past roughly 60 generation steps on coastline inputs, scenes drift toward repetitive texture - plausible locally, but a spell-breaker if a demo visitor flies straight ahead for two minutes. Kaia measured quality-vs-step curves on 40 held-out images; degradation onset is consistent around step 55-70.

Two mitigations for the June freeze, not mutually exclusive: (1) demo choreography - guided flight paths that vary heading, which keeps perceived quality high essentially indefinitely; (2) Kaia's re-grounding trick, periodically re-anchoring generation, which pushes onset past step 120 in early tests but needs the retrained checkpoint to validate properly.

Recommendation: plan the demo around (1), treat (2) as an upside from the June retraining week. Decision by mid-May keeps Oyin's frontend work unblocked.

Umar
